about_the_game:
This World Is Over is a survival and exploration game set in a post-apocalyptic world, developed with Unreal Engine 5. Play as Charlotte, a resource hunter in a world devastated by a deadly virus, where every decision you make will shape your destiny.

The Story

"It has been a year since the outbreak of that cursed virus. There is no cure; if you get infected, you become one of those damned things (zombies), unless you are part of the 1% who, for some cursed reason, are immune to the virus. A blessing? At first, you think it's a relief to be immune, yes, but after losing everyone you know, one by one... I wouldn't call that a 'blessing'. We were forced to abandon our towns and cities to scrape by in the mountains and the wasteland (desert). Most of us are immune, yes, but things haven't gotten better there either. Those damned raiders enforce the law of the strongest to steal the resources we work so hard to recover. Those of us who refuse to steal are scavengers or resource hunters, venturing into towns, cities, and dead zones to recover anything useful. You are our best resource hunter, Charlotte, and that has been your role until now. But you've earned the right to be free and go your own way. How you use that freedom is up to you. Out there, you have an entire world to write your own story, but remember... This world is over."

Main Features

  • Open World: Explore a vast and detailed post-apocalyptic world, filled with ruins, forests, abandoned cities, and secrets to uncover.
  • Survival: Manage your basic needs like hunger, thirst, and health while facing a hostile and threat-filled environment.
  • Crafting and Building: Create tools, weapons, and build shelters to protect yourself from the dangers lurking around every corner.
  • Combat and Escape: Face deadly enemies, such as zombies and raiders, or choose to flee and live another day. The choice is yours.

Personalized Story

  • Exploration: Discover ruins, forests, abandoned cities, and more.
  • Resource Gathering: Scavenge for scarce resources to survive and craft items.
  • Hunting and Food: Hunt animals, cook, and maintain your energy levels.
  • Building: Create safe shelters and customize them to your liking.
  • Enemies: Face zombies, bandits, and other desperate survivors.

What Will You Do to Survive?

In This World Is Over, every day is a challenge. Will you risk exploring a dangerous area in search of resources? Will you build a secure base or keep moving to avoid threats? The choice is yours, but remember... This world is over...

Get ready to dive into a world where survival is just the beginning, and every decision counts!

Important Note

The game is still in early development and may undergo changes in future development phases.

content_descriptors.notes: Violence, blood, horror, undead and other photorealistic aberrations that could hurt your sensibilities.

  • Processor: Rayzen 5
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4050 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Rayzen 7
  • Memory: 32 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 4060 or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 30 MB available space
